rules: Strict ban on Inter and Roboto for headings and titles.
Headings MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Currency and financial figures MUST use JetBrains Mono (font-mono) for tabular numerical alignment.
Overlines and table column headers MUST be uppercase, tiny (text-[11px] or text-xs) with tracking-widest.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow JavaScript (.js, .jsx) syntax in all created components, not TypeScript (.tsx).
Install and use lucide-react icons exclusively for standard visual cues.
Implement context switcher in Header so selecting a project filters or navigates to that project's finances immediately.
Include granular test IDs: every button, KPI card, tab, select input, and table row must have unique data-testid attributes.
Keep navigation clearly separated between Personal Finance (Core) and Projects (Specialized).
Design dedicated Lending Dashboard with distinct metrics: Total Lent, Recovered Amount, Overdue, Recovery Rate chart, and Person Ledger with 'Record Payment' button.
Design dedicated Access Control view where Admin can grant read/write/none permissions by role (Architect, Contractor A, Contractor B) across specific project modules.
Support both mobile responsive flow (bottom bar, sticky mini header, touchable action sheets) and dense desktop workstation view with collapsable sidebar.
DO NOT use transparent headers or dropdown backgrounds. Always provide backdrop-blur with minimum 80% opacity and subtle 1px border.
Use Recharts with the specific semantic finance color palette provided.
